messages:
Maya CSM: Heads up — ClearBridge (mid-market) flagged. Onboarding stalled at step 3, daily active tokens down 42% last 7 days, renewal in ~6 weeks. Thinking a micro-save rather than full GTM. 
Ethan (AM): Yikes. Any churn signals beyond usage? NPS? exec contact?
Maya CSM: NPS dropped to 6 in last pulse, primary complaints: confusion around model versioning + latency spikes on batch jobs. Exec contact still engaged but quiet.
Priya (Success Eng): Can we run a quick health-check runbook and offer a targeted enablement session? I can own a deep-dive on model routing + observability tweaks.
Jordan (PS): I'll prepare a 30-min playbook demo (how to pin models, fallback policies, cache tweaks). Recommend we offer 2 free hours of PS and a $1k credit to offset immediate churn risk.
Ethan (AM): Approve the offer. Maya, propose outreach message and timeline. We should aim for first touch within 48h.
Maya CSM: Draft outreach below — feel free to copy/edit:
```
Subject: Quick 30-min session to stabilize ClearBridge onboarding
Hi [Name],
We noticed some onboarding friction and usage drop. Can we hop on a 30-min session this week to tackle model routing + latency and get your team past step 3? We can include a PS deep-dive + $1,000 credit to cover any immediate infra tweaks.
Best,
Maya (CSM)
```
Priya (Success Eng): I'll attach a short diagnostics checklist to run before the call (KV cache sizes, batch window params, recent tail-latency traces). Link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/diag-checklist (internal)
Jordan (PS): I'll queue the demo deck and a checklist for success criteria. Can we make a canary rollback plan in case changes affect prod?
Maya CSM: Yes. Proposed timeline: Day 0 (48h) outreach sent; Day 2 session booked; Day 3-7 PS/SE work + credit applied; Day 10 check-in to confirm metrics recovery.
Ethan (AM): I'll notify the exec sponsor and offer an intro to our Head of Product if needed.
Priya (Success Eng): Ownership: Priya -> diagnostics + triage, Jordan -> PS deep-dive & rollback plan, Maya -> CSM outreach + exec touchpoint, Ethan -> commercial sign-off on credit.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up 10 days from now (1749916700). :white_check_mark:
Maya CSM: Cool. Capture outcomes in the account play doc: https://redwood.internal/cs-plays/clearbridge-microbump (internal). If usage recovers >=25% by Day 10 we close. If not, escalate to "dedicated retention" play and prepare downgrade-mitigation options.
Ethan (AM): Thanks team. I'll send the outreach now and loop in sponsor.
Priya (Success Eng): Ready on diagnostics. Ping me when session is booked.
Jordan (PS): Deck done, will share before the call.
Maya CSM: Closing loop — outreach sent at 09:04. Session booked for Thursday 14:00. Will update thread after call. :rocket:
